CI_CD_server.src.utils.code_quality package¶

CI_CD_server.src.utils.code_quality.check_syntax(file_path, email_response, logging)[source]¶

Check the syntax of a Python file using pylint.

This function runs pylint –errors-only to detect syntax errors in the given file. If syntax errors are found, they are logged and stored in the email response. If the file passes the syntax check, a success message is logged

Parameters:

  • file_path (str) – Path to the Python file to check

  • email_response – Object to store email content.

  • logging – Logger instance for recording operations

Returns:

(bool, str) -> True if syntax is valid, False if parsing errors found

Return type:

tuple

CI_CD_server.src.utils.code_quality.check_syntax_and_formatting(local_code_file, file_path, email_response, logging)[source]¶

Check and format Python source code files.

This function performs two operations: 1. Syntax validation using Python’s AST parser 2. Code formatting using Black (if syntax check passes)

Parameters:

  • local_code_file (str) – Path to the local copy of the file to check

  • file_path (str) – Original repository path of the file (for logging/reporting)

  • email_response – Email response object to append results

  • logging – Logger instance for recording operations

Returns:

True if syntax is valid and formatting succeeded, False otherwise Message: Error message if syntax check fails

Return type:

bool

CI_CD_server.src.utils.code_quality.format_file(file_path, email_response, local_code_file, logging)[source]¶

Format a Python file using Black code formatter.

This function runs black on the given file to ensure it is formatted according to the Black style guide. If formatting is successful, a success message is logged. If an error occurs during formatting, the error message is logged.

Parameters:

  • file_path (str) – The original path of the file in the repository.

  • email_response – The email response object to append formatting results.

  • local_code_file (str) – The local path to the code file to be formatted.

  • logging – Logger instance for recording operations

Returns:

The result of the Black formatting if successful. None: If the formatting fails.

Return type:

subprocess.CompletedProcess
